text: What are your concerns with the tax credit bill? (You can only get a reimbursement for expenses, not just a straight $5,000.) Are there any proposals that would use public money for private education that you would entertain? If more and more states are adopting this, and the governor after seven years is willing to entertain this, is there any point at which you say, you know, this proposal doesn’t divert existing money from schools, so let’s give it a try? What else is on your priority list for education?
